description: Angular component for configuring geofencing zone groups within the Thingsboard platform, including form handling, validation, and interaction logic.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldGeofencingZoneGroupsPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing geofencing zone group configurations, including form setup, validation, and user interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form, sets validators, patches data, and configures component state based on inputs.

methods.name: fetchOptions
methods.description: Provides autocomplete options for certain form fields based on search text.

methods.name: saveZone
methods.description: Emits the configured geofencing zone data after processing form values.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Hides the popover component without saving changes.

methods.name: updateEntityFilter
methods.description: Updates the entity filter based on the selected entity type.

methods.name: observeEntityFilterChanges
methods.description: Sets up subscriptions to form control changes to update entity filter accordingly.

methods.name: observeEntityTypeChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to the entity type selection, enabling/disabling form controls and resetting values.

methods.name: levelsRequired
methods.description: Validator function ensuring at least one level is added.

methods.name: levelsFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array managing levels.

methods.name: trackByKey
methods.description: Track function for drag-and-drop reordering of levels.

methods.name: removeKey
methods.description: Removes a level at a specified index.

methods.name: addKey
methods.description: Adds a new level to the levels array.

methods.name: dragEnabled
methods.description: Determines if drag-and-drop is enabled based on form state.
